# BitField

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Integer word (status or fault word, register) shown as a row of indicators, one per bit (IND-111, IND-112).

![BitField, light theme](../img/widgets/bit-field-light.png#only-light){ width="528" }
![BitField, dark theme](../img/widgets/bit-field-dark.png#only-dark){ width="528" }

**Indicators, discrete** · [Widget catalog](../widgets.md) · [API reference](../api.md#anywidget_instruments.BitField) ·
schema [`bitfield.schema.json`](../trait-contract.md)

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.BitField(
    value=2067,
    label="BitField (drive status word)",
    labels=[
        "Ready",
        "Running",
        "Warning",
        "At speed",
        "Fault",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "Remote",
        "",
        "",
        "Brake",
        "",
        "",
        "",
        "",
    ],
    colors=["", "", "#f59e0b", "", "#dc2626"],
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `"control"`, `"indicator"` | `"indicator"` | host | "control": the user sets the value; "indicator": display only. |
| `size` | array | `[520,76]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | integer | `0` | host, widget | The word; bit 0 is the least significant bit. Must be below 2**bits (Python rejects larger values; the front end shows only the bits of the word). Set by the host, or by the user toggling a bit in control mode (IND-112). |
| `bits` | `8`, `16`, `32` | `16` | host | Word size. |
| `labels` | array of string | `[]` | host | Label of each bit, bit 0 first; a bit without a label is shown dimmed. |
| `colors` | array of string | `[]` | host | CSS on color of each bit, bit 0 first; empty or missing: on_color. |
| `on_color` | string | `"#22c55e"` | host | CSS color of a set bit. |
| `msb_first` | boolean | `true` | host | Draw the most significant bit on the left, as the word is written. |
| `show_hex` | boolean | `true` | host | Also show the word in hexadecimal. |
